name: beso-plugins
description: Beso's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: besovantue
plugins.description: Reminds Claude to check reference sources before updating Claude Code settings/config/docs; includes /init to generate persistent codebase summary docs, /spec-plan to draft implementation plans, /plan-review to independently audit them, /implement to build one plan task at a time, /impl-review to audit that task's code, and /code-review to audit any code change without a plan, all into cdocs/
